rows.answer: Every full-time employee is entitled to 30 calendar days of paid annual leave per year. [1] Employees receive 15 days of sick leave per year at full pay, followed by 10 days at half pay. [2]
Employees may carry over a maximum of 10 unused days into the next calendar year; any balance above 10 days is forfeited on 31 March. [1]

Employees receive 15 days of sick leave per year at full pay, followed by 10 days at half pay. [1] A medical certificate from a licensed clinic is required for any absence longer than two consecutive days. [1]
New employees serve a probation period of 100 days. [1] After probation, the notice period is 30 days for staff and 60 days for managers and above. [1]
After passing probation, employees may work remotely up to two days per week, with the written approval of their line manager. [2]
Each employee has an annual training budget of 400 KWD, which can be used for courses, certifications and conference tickets related to their role. [1]
Directors may fly business class on flights longer than six hours. [1]
The hotel limit is 45 KWD per night inside the GCC and 70 KWD per night elsewhere. [1]
A daily allowance (per diem) of 25 KWD covers meals and local transport on travel days. [1] All business trips must be approved by the line manager before any booking is made. [2]
Orders to other GCC countries (Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain, Qatar and Oman) are delivered within five to seven working days through our courier partner. [1]
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 working days after we receive and inspect the returned item. [1]

Installed water filters and opened filter cartridges cannot be returned for hygiene reasons, unless they are faulty. [1] Falak gift cards are valid for one year from the date of purchase and can be used for any product or for the Falak Care filter subscription. [2]

Employees who resign must return their laptop, badge and any company equipment on their last working day. [1] If your order arrives damaged or you receive the wrong item, report it within 48 hours of delivery through the app or the website, with photos of the item and the packaging. [2]
